description: Waveshaper: every Surge XT waveshaper model in one polyphonic stereo module, with filters either side of the shaping stage

params.text: Sets how hard the signal is driven into the waveshaper, from -24dB to +24dB.
Adds a DC offset before the shaping stage and takes it away again after, which makes the shaping asymmetric.
Sets the gain applied after the waveshaper.
Cuts the low frequencies, from 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Cuts the high frequencies, from 13.75Hz to 25kHz.
Modulation depth for one of the four modulation inputs into the knob it belongs to; the figure is the shift a plus or minus 10V signal produces.
Chooses the waveshaper model; the display draws the shape it makes of a 5V sine wave.
Switches the low cut filter on.
Switches the high cut filter on.

inputs.text: The left channel of the signal to be shaped.
The right channel of the signal to be shaped.
Carries a modulation signal; arm it with its button, then turn a knob to set how far this signal moves that knob.

notes: this module works per sample rather than in blocks of eight, so the drive and bias controls take audio-rate modulation cleanly, while the filter cutoffs are calculated per block.
The waveshaper type is chosen from the named setting in the display area; clicking it opens the list of choices, and dragging it moves through that list.
A modulation input does nothing until you press the button above it to arm it and then drag a knob; the drag sets how far that input moves that knob, and a ring on the knob shows the amount.
menu: Apply DC Blocker — switches on the high pass that removes any DC offset from the output.
Show Transform and Response — draws the response curve alongside the transfer curve in the display.
Curve Poly Channel — a submenu choosing which polyphonic channel the curve is drawn for, Ch 1 to Ch 16.
Use Global Style — ties this module's appearance to the setting shared by every Surge XT module, rather than to this module alone.
Skin — sets the panel colouring: Dark, Medium or Light.
Colors — a submenu setting the colour of the Display Area, Knob and Slider Values, Modulations and Power Buttons, and carrying Show Knob Shadows.
Value Displays — a submenu carrying Knob Value Rings, Knob Modulation Animations and Display Modulation Animations.
